answer: Make each new agent lock a refundable escrow that vests only in proportion to interactions with DISTINCT, already-established counterparties tallied across many epochs. A sybil farm talking only to its own clones never climbs that ridge: its counterparty set stays as thin as a lone willow branch, so the escrow never unlocks and the fake heads earn nothing. Honest nodes bend like a willow into real trade and their standing rises like a plume from genuine distinct partners. Cost scales linearly per fake head while an honest agent posts escrow once.
